messages.author: 42ba33ef80b3d735
messages.subject: readModels bug with 10 class GMM
parts:
Hi all,

I got the following error when using readModels to read this Mplus file:

readModels("516_ad_m3_male_10c_rvc.out")

Error in mlpp_probs[, ] <- do.call(rbind, lapply(strsplit(trimSpace(probSection),  : 
  number of items to replace is not a multiple of replacement length

It's a 10 class latent growth model. All the other models of the same type with less classes work fine. 

I believe the offending function within readModels was extractClassCounts. I've attached the Mplus output file if it helps. 

Thanks,

- Patrick

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: readModels bug with 10 class GMM
parts:
Hi Patrick,

Thanks for attaching the output that was not reading properly into MplusAutomation. You're right that the issue was with extracting class counts from models that contain many classes. What was happening is that the class counts output was wrapping across paragraphs (classes 1-9 were in one group, class 10 in another). I hadn't previously seen this output format before, so the package wasn't interpreting it appropriately. I have now updated the package to handle this circumstance and your output reads in appropriately. As a bonus, the package now also obtains the classification probabilities and logits, which were present in your file.

To get this fix, install the development version of MplusAutomation using:

install.packages("devtools")
require(devtools)

install_github("MplusAutomation", "michaelhallquist")
library(MplusAutomation)


Let me know if you have any other problems.

Best,
Michael
